mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS purchaseReceiptId, r.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, r.supplier_id AS supplierId, r.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplierNameSnapshot, r.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt FROM purchase_receipt r WHERE r.id = #{purchaseReceiptId} AND r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED'

SELECT ri.id AS purchaseReceiptItemId, ri.purchase_order_item_id AS purchaseOrderItemId, ri.sku_id AS skuId, ri.sku_name_snapshot AS skuNameSnapshot, ri.purchase_unit_snapshot AS unitSnapshot, ri.received_quantity AS quantity, oi.purchase_price AS unitPrice FROM purchase_receipt_item ri JOIN purchase_order_item oi ON oi.id = ri.purchase_order_item_id WHERE ri.purchase_receipt_id = #{purchaseReceiptId} AND ri.deleted = FALSE AND ri.received_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ri.sort_order, ri.id
